notes.title: War Dots 1.0.10
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Units will now change targets faster after the previous one dies.
[*]Units will now properly change targets after destroying a building.
[/list]

notes.title: Small QoL update
notes.notes: Academy files button in the mission selection menu will only be clickable when containing new informations.

notes.title: War Dots 1.0.8 - Unit AI update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] You could sometimes notice units acting kind of chaotic, this update makes them act more logical and predictable, properly trying to attack the closest enemy.
[*] Adjusted resources on some levels
[*] Fixed bug with pirate sprite's resolution
[/list]

notes.title: War Dots 1.0.7 - Difficulty tweaks
notes.notes:
While the game is meant to be challenging, sometimes it felt rather punishing than challenging. 
These changes should smooth out the difficulty, especially in the beginning.

[list]
[*]added 1 gold per second on ALL levels, to avoid situations when you're left with nothing 
[*]Increased spawn rate of knights on level 20, from 10 seconds to 9 seconds
[*]increased base gold on level 27, from 15 to 25, allowing smoother start
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfix 1.0.5
notes.notes:
-Slightly lowered difficulty of level 20
-Fixed a bug with unlocking level 27

notes.title: Restart Button added
notes.notes: Previously restarting the level could only be done via backspace, now there's dedicated button in pause menu too.

notes.title: Save Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed the bug that blocked progressing the game past level 2.
